map.创业公司现金消耗分析，计算月净消耗、现金跑道与资金耗尽日期: Startup cash consumption analysis: computes monthly net burn, cash runway and the date funds run out
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：netBurn × 18: Core formula (by input variable): netBurn x 18
map.月总支出（工资 + 房租 + 营销 + 其他）即毛烧钱率(gross burn): Total monthly spending (salaries + rent + marketing + other) is the gross burn rate; the net burn rate = monthly spending - monthly revenue, and a negative value means cash flow has turned positive.
map.跑道 = 账面现金 ÷ 净烧钱率；按跑道长短给预警：<6 月高危、<9 月加速融: Runway = cash on hand / net burn rate; use the runway length for alerts: under 6 months is high risk, under 9 months means accelerate fundraising, under 12 months means plan the raise.
map.按「保留 18 个月跑道」反推融资额：需融资 = 净烧钱率 × 18 − 当前现: Work backwards from "keep an 18-month runway": funding needed = net burn rate x 18 - current cash (a financing round is needed only when this is positive).
map.可复现算例（现金 50 万，月入 2 万，月支 12.5 万）: Reproducible example (cash 500,000 CNY, monthly income 20,000 CNY, monthly spending 125,000 CNY)
map.月支出 = 8 + 1.5 + 2 + 1 = 12.5 万元；净烧钱 = 12:
Monthly spending = 80,000 + 15,000 + 20,000 + 10,000 = 125,000 CNY; net burn = 125,000 - 20,000 = 105,000 CNY per month; gross burn = 125,000 CNY.
Runway = 500,000 / 105,000 = 4.8 months → below 6 months, triggering the high-risk alert, so raise funds now or cut non-essential spending.
18-month target cash = 105,000 x 18 = 1,890,000 CNY; suggested raise = 1,890,000 - 500,000 = 1,390,000 CNY (including buffer).
map.毛烧和净烧有什么区别？: What is the difference between gross and net burn?
map.毛烧钱率 = 每月总支出（不含收入）；净烧钱率 = 支出 − 收入。有收入时用净: Gross burn rate = total monthly spending (excluding revenue); net burn rate = spending - revenue. Once there is revenue, net burn measures the real consumption, and the runway is computed on net burn too - the higher the revenue, the longer the runway.
map.融资从启动到到账常需 3–9 个月，18 个月缓冲能覆盖融资周期 + 执行偏差，: Raising funds often takes 3-9 months from launch to money in the bank, and an 18-month buffer covers the fundraising period plus execution variance, avoiding forced low-priced financing at the trough. The formula is net burn x 18, and the shortfall is the suggested round size.
